name: LotteryTicketSwap50 live-reserve redemption misprices LP
summary: LotteryTicketSwap50 swapped and added ticket deposits at the NATA/USDC pair's spot reserves without slippage bounds, and redeemed tickets for fixed USDC by burning protocol-owned LP sized from live reserves. A flash-loan skew of the pair let the attacker buy tickets, recapture the mispriced deposit swap and redeem the tickets from protocol LP.
notes: The last enabling grant was the factory whitelisting router 0x09923035 on the pair: redemptions sell through it and it calls the pair's whitelist-gated subPool. Replaying the exploit at block 30001612 with that slot cleared reverts (NostrSwap: Transfer Not Allowed); clearing flag1 or the ticket mint grant, both set earlier, also reverts.

Victims are the pair and LotteryTicketSwap50, whose LP the owner and the contract held; their net USDC loss is counted. The NATA the router burned from the pair to the dead address went to no one and is not valued separately; the LP tokens are not counted beside their underlying.
